newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Carpenter says Mt Kare licence renewed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Carpenter says Mt Kare licence renewed.

text.p: Carpenter Pacific Resources NL said on Monday that its exploration licence at Mt Kare in Papua New Guinea has been renewed, with a 10 percent rise in the landowners' interest.
Trading in Carpenter shares was halted before the start of trade on Monday at the company's request.

Carpenter said the interest of the landowners' company, Mt Kare Gold Resources Pty Ltd, would rise from 20 percent to 30 percent. However, landowners would no longer have a 10 percent free carried interest.
The increase depended on Mt Kare Gold taking part in a genealogy study and persuading the Papua New Guinea government that all landowner groups were represented, Carpenter said.
Carpenter is exploring for hardrock gold mineralisation in the Highlands region which has yielded more than a million ounces of alluvial gold.
